name: rest: in a dark room
source:
In 1954, John C. Lilly created the sensory deprivation tank to isolate the mind from the world. Decades later, seventeen-year-old Charlotte craves the same escape, cutting herself off from human connection. 

But when a bold, overbearing stranger intervenes, her solitary path grows strange – and every choice with several other girls will shape her fate.

[Edited from [url=https://regularglove.itch.io/rest-in-a-dark-room-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1954年，约翰·C·礼来（John C. Lilly）发明了感觉剥夺罐，将思想与世界隔离。几十年后，十七岁的夏洛特渴望同样的逃避，切断与人的联系。

但当一个大胆、专横的陌生人介入时，她孤独的道路变得奇怪——与其他几个女孩的每一个选择都将决定她的命运。

[编辑自[url=https://regularglove.itch.io/rest-in-a-dark-room-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
